description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM DOOR HINGES for the Driver and Passenger Doors.
Does BOTH Doors
Comes Primed and Ready to Paint
NOTE: The Driver side is the same set, but needs to be flipped upside down. This will leave the pin upside down and may not work for Removable Doors without welding the other side of the pin.
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Pair of Hinges for Passenger Side (RH) Door
Qty 1 – Pair of Hinges for Driver Side (LH) Door
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
